title: LTE Single UE Attach and Detach under Excellent Radio Conditions
description: Validate successful LTE E-UTRAN initial attach and UE-initiated detach procedure for a single UE under excellent radio conditions over 10 iterations.
preconditions: Single isolated LTE cell is configured and activated with no interference.
Single UE (real or emulated) placed at cell center under excellent LTE RSRP conditions as per Clause 4.6.
All other cells are powered off.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Start log capture to record call flow and signaling messages.
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure.
Wait for attach complete message confirming successful attach.
Verify UE is attached to correct LTE cell (check PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN).
Power OFF the UE to initiate UE-initiated detach procedure.
Wait for detach accept message confirming successful detach.
Stop log capture and save logs for analysis.
Repeat the above steps 10 times.
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100%.
Detach success rate is 100%.
Attach latency is measured and minimum, average, maximum values are recorded.
Logs confirm correct signaling flows for attach and detach procedures.
UE remains attached to correct cell during attach.
postconditions: UE is detached from the network.
Logs are saved for KPI measurement.
verificationMethods: Analyze captured logs for attach request and attach complete messages.
Analyze logs for detach request and detach accept messages.
Check UE cell identity parameters in logs or UE application.
Measure attach latency from attach request to attach complete.

title: 5G NSA Single UE Attach and Detach with Secondary Node Addition and Release
description: Validate successful 5G NSA attach with EN-DC secondary node addition and UE-initiated detach with secondary node release over 10 iterations under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single isolated cell configured for 5G NSA (LTE + NR) with no interference.
Single UE (real or emulated) placed at cell center under excellent 5G SS-RSRP conditions as per Clause 4.6.
All other cells powered off.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Start log capture to record call flow and signaling messages.
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach procedure.
Wait for attach complete message confirming successful attach.
Verify UE is attached to correct LTE and 5G cells (check PCI, Global eNB ID/gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN).
Validate secondary node addition by checking SgNB addition request and SgNB reconfiguration complete messages.
Power OFF the UE to initiate UE-initiated detach procedure.
Wait for detach accept message and successful secondary node release signaling.
Stop log capture and save logs for analysis.
Repeat the above steps 10 times.
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100%.
Secondary node addition success rate is 100%.
Detach success rate is 100%.
Attach latency metrics recorded with minimum, average, maximum values.
Correct signaling flows for attach, secondary node addition, detach, and secondary node release observed in logs.
UE attached to correct LTE and NR cells.
postconditions: UE is detached from the network and secondary node context is released.
Logs saved for KPI measurements.
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for attach request, attach complete, SgNB addition request, and SgNB reconfiguration complete messages.
Analyze logs for detach request, detach accept, and secondary node release signaling.
Check UE cell identity parameters in UE logs or applications.
Measure attach latency from attach request to attach complete.

title: Attach Failure due to Poor Radio Conditions
description: Verify that LTE or 5G NSA attach fails when UE is placed under poor radio conditions below the minimum coupling loss.
preconditions: Single isolated cell configured for LTE or 5G NSA.
UE placed under poor radio conditions below minimum coupling loss as defined in Clause 4.6.
testSteps: Start log capture.
Power ON the UE to initiate attach procedure.
Wait for attach procedure to complete or timeout.
Stop log capture.
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails within defined timeout.
Attach success rate is 0% or below acceptable threshold.
Logs show attach request sent but no attach complete received.
UE remains detached.
postconditions: UE remains detached from the network.
Logs saved for failure analysis.
verificationMethods: Review logs for absence of attach complete messages.
Verify UE status indicates attach failure.
Check radio parameter reports showing poor RSRP or SS-RSRP.

title: Detach Failure Due to Signaling Loss
description: Simulate signaling connection loss during UE-initiated detach to verify system behavior and recovery.
preconditions: Single isolated cell configured for LTE or 5G NSA.
UE is successfully attached under excellent radio conditions.
testSteps: Start log capture.
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach procedure.
Simulate signaling link failure or loss during detach signaling exchange.
Observe system reaction and retry mechanisms.
Stop log capture.
expectedResults: System retries detach signaling as per protocol.
Detach success rate eventually reaches 100% after recovery or appropriate failure indication is logged.
UE context is released or cleaned up after failure.
No resource leak or stuck states in network elements.
postconditions: UE detached or network context cleared.
Logs saved with failure and recovery details.
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for signaling retries and error messages.
Check network element states for resource release.
Verify UE status after failure.

title: Attach and Detach with Minimum Coupling Loss Boundary Radio Conditions
description: Verify attach and detach success when UE is placed at the boundary of minimum coupling loss to test edge radio coverage conditions.
preconditions: Single isolated cell configured for LTE or 5G NSA.
UE positioned to experience radio conditions exactly at minimum coupling loss limit.
testSteps: Start log capture.
Power ON the UE and wait for attach completion.
Verify attach success and measure attach latency.
Power OFF the UE and wait for detach completion.
Stop log capture.
Repeat for 10 iterations.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rate of 100% at boundary radio conditions.
Attach latency within acceptable limits.
No abnormal signaling or errors in logs.
postconditions: UE detached after test completion.
Logs saved for KPI analysis.
verificationMethods: Analyze captured logs for successful signaling.
Check radio parameters to confirm minimum coupling loss conditions.
Measure attach latency values.

title: Attach and Detach with Intermittent Radio Conditions Fluctuation
description: Test UE attach and detach behavior when radio conditions fluctuate around threshold between excellent and poor during test iterations.
preconditions: Single isolated cell configured for LTE or 5G NSA.
Radio conditions are dynamically modified to fluctuate around excellent and minimum coupling loss boundary.
testSteps: Start log capture.
Power ON the UE and attempt attach.
Record success/failure and attach latency.
Power OFF the UE and attempt detach.
Repeat steps for 10 iterations with radio condition fluctuations.
Stop log capture.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rate varies according to radio conditions.
Attach latency shows variance correlated to radio conditions.
No system crashes or stuck states during fluctuations.
postconditions: UE detached after test completion.
Logs saved with radio condition and performance correlation.
verificationMethods: Correlate radio parameter logs with attach/detach success and latency.
Analyze logs for signaling robustness during radio changes.

preconditions: Single isolated cell configured and activated.
Single UE placed under excellent radio conditions.
testSteps: Start log capture.
Power ON the UE to initiate attach.
Record timestamp of attach request and attach complete.
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach.
Repeat for 10 iterations.
Calculate min, average, and max attach latency.
Stop log capture.
expectedResults: Attach latency metrics are reliably captured and within expected target KPIs.
Attach and detach success rate is 100%.
No abnormal delays or failures observed.
postconditions: UE detached after tests.
Logs saved for latency KPI reporting.
verificationMethods: Analyze logs to extract attach request and attach complete timestamps.
Calculate latency values and compare with expected targets.

title: Attach and Detach Success Rate Measurement Over 10 Iterations
description: Measure and record attach and detach success rates over 10 consecutive attach-detach cycles for a single UE.
preconditions: Single isolated cell configured for LTE or 5G NSA.
UE under excellent radio conditions.
testSteps: Start log capture.
Perform 10 attach-detach cycles by powering ON and OFF the UE.
For each iteration, verify attach and detach success.
Stop log capture.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates are 100%.
No failed attempts during test cycles.
Logs confirm all signaling flows are successfully completed.
postconditions: UE detached after test.

Calculate success rates from logs.

title: Integration Testing of LTE Attach and Detach with Core Network Elements
description: Validate end-to-end LTE attach and detach procedures including signaling interactions between UE, eNB, and core network components.
preconditions: Test environment includes eNB, MME, and EPC components configured.
Single UE placed under excellent radio conditions.
testSteps: Start capture on UE, eNB, and core network nodes.
Power ON UE to initiate attach.
Verify signaling flow through eNB to MME and EPC for attach request and response.
Power OFF UE to initiate detach.
Verify signaling flow for detach request and response through all network components.
Stop captures.
expectedResults: Attach and detach signaling flows are correctly exchanged end-to-end.
No signaling errors or dropped messages.
UE context properly created and released in all elements.
KPIs recorded and match expected values.
postconditions: UE detached and all network contexts cleared.
Signaling logs saved for analysis.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling traces from UE, eNB, MME, and EPC nodes.
Verify correct message sequences per 3GPP TS 23.401 and TS 37.340.
Check KPI tables for success rates.

title: Integration Testing of 5G NSA Attach and Secondary Node Addition and Release
description: Validate end-to-end 5G NSA attach with EN-DC secondary node addition and release including interactions between eNB, gNB, and core network.
preconditions: Test setup includes LTE eNB, 5G gNB, AMF, and other 5G core components.
Single UE under excellent radio conditions.
testSteps: Start logging on UE, eNB, gNB, and core network nodes.
Power ON UE to initiate 5G NSA attach.
Verify signaling flow for attach and EN-DC secondary node addition (SgNB addition request and reconfiguration).
Power OFF UE for UE-initiated detach and secondary node release.
Verify secondary node release signaling flow per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1.
Stop logging and save captures.
expectedResults: Complete and correct signaling flows for attach, secondary node addition, detach, and secondary node release.
No signaling errors.
Proper UE context management across MN and SN.
KPIs recorded as per test requirements.
postconditions: UE detached and secondary node context released.
Logs saved for detailed analysis.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling messages across all involved nodes.
Confirm compliance with relevant 3GPP procedures.
Verify KPI measurements.

Perform 10 attach-detach cycles with real UE and record KPIs.
Perform 10 attach-detach cycles with UE emulator and record KPIs.
Compare attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates are 100% for both UE types.
Attach latency values are within comparable ranges.
Signaling flows conform to standards for both UE types.
No compatibility issues observed.

Perform 10 attach-detach cycles and record KPIs.
Reconfigure network for 5G NSA mode.
Perform 10 attach-detach cycles and record KPIs.
Compare results between LTE and 5G NSA modes.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates are 100% in both configurations.
Attach latency and secondary node addition/release KPIs measured and within targets.
No compatibility or functionality issues noted during transitions.
verificationMethods: Analyze KPI tables for both configurations.

Check UE cell attachment parameters.
